verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs show Neovim as the default editor, with VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime Text, Helix, Vim and Emacs ready to install. Rails, Laravel, Node.js and many other development environments install from the menu, with Mise managing language versions, and Claude Code and OpenCode ship as default AI agent harnesses. A hands-on user also reports software installs being easy and fast. missing for 10: evidence of ML frameworks or GPU-compute stacks (CUDA/PyTorch), explicit assurance of latest/rolling package versions, and evidence that vendors treat this platform as primary-supported.
